title: Planck's base-ΛCDM conclusions give σ8 = 0.811 ± 0.006
summary: The conclusions state a late-time clustering amplitude σ8 = 0.811 ± 0.006 for the base-ΛCDM cosmology.
body: The conclusions of Planck 2018 results VI say the Planck base-ΛCDM cosmology predicts a late-time clustering amplitude σ8 = 0.811 ± 0.006. The same bullet also states a matter density that is already on the existing big-bang card. This card keeps the clustering amplitude. σ8 is a derived parameter of that cosmology, a measure of the amplitude of matter fluctuations, not a headcount of galaxies.
